messages:
michelle_cs: FYI AcmeCorp just sent a SIG/CAIQ + a 27-page bespoke security questionnaire. They flagged questions about KMS/HSM attestations, audit log retention, and proof of exportability. They want answers by EOD Friday. Need help pulling artifacts and clarifications on what we can attest to.
ajay_eng: Can you paste the exact questions they called out? do we have a copy of the bespoke form? link if possible.
michelle_cs: Pasted the snippets they highlighted in the thread. Main ask: 1) "Can you provide HSM attestation for key storage used for customer data?" 2) "Audit log retention policy and ability to export immutable logs for compliance review." 3) "Data retention/erase proofs for ephemeral request logs." They attached a PDF; dropping link to the ticket: https://tickets.redwood/acme/SEC-1242
olivia_csm: I've replied to the customer saying we're escalating to security + infra and will share a timeline. They pushed back on timeline — said their internal audit window closes Fri COB.
samir_sec: I can own the attestation doc. Quick heads up on product facts: hosted customers use our managed keys; Dedicated & Private can bring their own KMS and for Private we support CloudHSM integrations and HSM-backed keys via our KMS adapter. We don't currently ship third-party HSM attestation artifacts for hosted customers by default.
ryan_oncall: Regarding audit logs — last week a different customer mentioned a missing audit event set; we have an export tool. You can run:

```
redwoodctl logs export --since=2024-10-01 --until=2024-10-31 --customer acmecorp --type audit --format ndjson > acme-audit-2024-10.ndjson
```

That produces an immutable ndjson bundle and a sha256 checksum. I can run it and stage the artifact in a signed S3 location if you want.
michelle_cs: That command is perfect. Can you run it and share the signed URL + checksum? We need to attach it to the SIG/CAIQ evidence pack.
ryan_oncall: Running now. Note: if the customer is hosted, some entries are aggregated; we can also produce per-token/session traces but need a signed NDA for session-level PII. For compliance pack we'll export the audit event types they asked for: auth, key-ops, admin, config-change.
ajay_eng: For the KMS/HSM attestation: we should be explicit in the questionnaire. Suggest language: "Hosted: keys are managed by Redwood's KMS; production key material for hosted customers is stored on provider-managed HSMs (cloud KMS), and operational controls are documented. Dedicated/Private customers can configure customer-managed KMS/HSM — see integration guide: https://docs.redwood/secure/kms-integration". Samir, can you sign off on that wording?
samir_sec: That wording is fine but we must avoid implying hardware proofs for hosted unless we provide a specific attest artifact. I'll draft a short attestation template: "Redwood Inference confirms that for Dedicated and Private deployments, keys may be configured with customer-managed HSMs and attestations can be provided. For the Redwood-hosted service, key wrapping and encryption are performed using cloud provider KMS; for customers requiring FIPS-140 level attestations, we recommend Dedicated/Private deployments." I'll attach the template.
ops-bot: export job started by ryan_oncall for customer=acmecorp job_id=exp-9734
michelle_cs: Also they want retention policy specifics: how long audit logs kept by default, where they are stored, access controls, and retention delete windows. Olivia, can you confirm SLAs we promised in contract?
olivia_csm: Contract says 90 days of hot audit retention and 1 year cold archive for hosted plans; Dedicated/Private retention is configurable in contract. I'll attach the contract excerpt to the case.
ajay_eng: For the bespoke form, draft answers should map to SIG/CAIQ control IDs so they can crosswalk. Samir — once you have the attestation language I'll map it to CAIQ items (eg. SA-3, SC-8 equivalents). I can also include the export commands and the ndjson artifact id as evidence.
samir_sec: Draft attached. Key points: 1) We can provide audit log exports and checksums on request; 2) We do not provide raw HSM attestations for hosted tenants without additional contractual terms; 3) We offer Private deployments with HSM-backed keys and can produce attestation artifacts under enterprise agreements. I'll produce a signed PDF statement.
ryan_oncall: Export finished: s3://signed-artifacts/acme/exp-9734/acme-audit-2024-10.ndjson (signed URL created, expires in 7 days). checksum: sha256:3b7f9c1a7b8e5f2d4f6a9e0c2b1f5d6a7c8e9f0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2
michelle_cs: Thanks. I'll attach that to the response. Can someone prepare a short bullet list for the questionnaire fields they highlighted so we can send a single consolidated response? Keep it non-technical for legal/audit reviewers.
ajay_eng: I'll prepare a short non-technical summary + technical appendix with commands & artifact IDs. Samir please review for tone/accuracy.
samir_sec: Will review. Also recommend offering an FAQ: "How to get HSM attestation" with steps and lead time (2-4 weeks after contract amendment). That usually solves the negotiation.
michelle_cs: Great. I'll tell Acme we'll respond by Thu noon (gives time for review) and include the export artifact + attestation template + contract excerpt. Thanks all :)
